Brain normative atlas explorer

Neuromorphometrics atlas. Click any region in the slices or on the 3D brain.

Your participants

Drop a CSV or TSV file anywhere on this page, or choose one. One row per participant; columns are atlas regions in any order (short names like lHip_GM_Vol or lHip_CSF_Vol, or atlas names like Left Hippocampus_GM_Vol), plus age and sex, and optionally TIV (raw volumes are then scaled to TIV = 1500 ml automatically). The file is read on this computer only and is never sent anywhere.

Loading the atlas…
This app makes no network connections: everything you open in it stays on your computer. Labels: Neuromorphometrics atlas as distributed with SPM12 (MICCAI 2012 multi-atlas labelling data, CC BY-NC). MRI scans originate from the OASIS project; labelled data provided by Neuromorphometrics, Inc. under academic subscription. Background contrast is synthesised from SPM12 tissue probability maps. Display follows neurological convention (left is left).
